# SampleOpen downloadable models

Example data for development. These are not real models.

## model: sampleopen-8b-q4
- name: SampleOpen 8B Q4
- params_b: 8
- quantization: Q4_K_M
- weights_gb: 4.9
- max_context: 131072
- layers: 32
- kv_heads: 8
- head_dim: 128
- commercial_use: yes
- suitable_for: coding, writing, studying
- setup_hours: 2
